cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-open-mounts-and-close-releases
cases.purpose: Opening mounts the chat list and connection status; closing releases the client.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-select-chat-loads-history
cases.purpose: Selecting a chat loads and shows its recent messages.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-composer-sends-and-clears-on-ack
cases.purpose: The in-layout composer sends typed text and clears it only after acceptance.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-draft-survives-until-ack
cases.purpose: An unacknowledged send keeps the draft text for retry.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-chat-keys-move-the-selection
cases.purpose: The next and previous chat keys move the selected conversation.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-live-message-appends-to-the-open-chat
cases.purpose: A message arriving while a chat is open is appended after the loaded history.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-live-message-deduplicates-by-id
cases.purpose: Delivering the same message twice still shows one copy.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-live-copy-of-the-draft-keeps-it-until-ack
cases.purpose: Another client's copy of the draft text does not clear the draft; only the send acknowledgement does.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-first-and-last-chat-commands
cases.purpose: The first and last chat commands jump to the ends of the conversation list.
